fato_historico: 1948: Margaret Chase Smith is elected United States senator, and becomes the first woman to serve in both the U.S. House of Representatives and the United States Senate.
energia_do_dia: Today may bring a refreshing breeze of empowerment to your professional world. Much like a historic trailblazer who stepped into new legislative chambers, consider that you too possess the strength to break boundaries. It is a good time to trust your unique path and voice, as your dedication may finally open doors you previously thought were locked tight.
frase_do_dia: Believe in the power of your own voice and step forward with confidence today.
significado_numero: Represents the completion of a cycle and the beginning of success.
conselho: Trust your inner wisdom and take that bold first step toward your dreams.
